audit_headline: With only 10 reviews and the most recent from 5 years ago, Rimmer Electric's biggest opportunity is to restart review collection to show current customers that this 4.6-star electrician is still active and excellent.
summary: Rimmer Electric is a Shreveport electrician with a 4.6-star rating from 10 reviews, a phone number and website on the profile, and complete weekday hours (7 AM–4 PM, closed weekends). The profile is accurate and the website is solid, but the most recent review visible is from 5 years ago—meaning the profile looks dormant to searchers comparing options. Restarting review collection and adding LocalBusiness structured data are the highest-impact moves available.

sections.title: Google Business Profile
sections.summary: The profile is complete and accurate: primary category is Electrician, phone (318) 221-7490 and website are present, hours are listed for Monday–Friday 7 AM–4 PM (closed weekends), and the profile shows 10 or more photos.

findings.observation: The profile lists complete weekday hours (Monday–Friday 7 AM–4 PM) and is marked closed on Saturday and Sunday, which accurately reflects a commercial-hours electrician but leaves no coverage for evening or weekend emergencies.
findings.recommendation: If Rimmer Electric offers after-hours or emergency service, add that information to the profile description or services list so searchers know how to reach you outside 7–4 weekday hours.

findings.observation: The primary category is Electrician, which is the correct fit for this business, and the profile includes phone, website, and address—all core signals are present.

The profile shows 10 photos, which is the API floor and likely means 10 or more; photo depth is adequate but adding recent project photos (panels, installations, team at work) can strengthen relevance and trust.
findings.recommendation: Upload 5–10 new photos showing recent electrical work, your team, and your service area to keep the visual profile fresh and relevant.

sections.title: Reviews & Reputation
sections.summary: Rimmer Electric has a strong 4.6-star rating from 10 reviews, but the most recent review visible is from 5 years ago—making the profile appear inactive to searchers comparing electricians today.

findings.observation: The profile has only 10 reviews total, and the most recent one visible is from 5 years ago; this low volume and stale recency signal to searchers that the business may not be active or may not prioritize customer feedback.
findings.recommendation: Restart review collection immediately: ask every satisfied customer for a Google review via text or email after job completion, aiming for 2–3 new reviews per month to demonstrate current activity and quality.

findings.observation: The 4.6-star rating is strong, and the five visible recent reviews are all 5-star; two mention professionalism and promptness, one highlights customer service, and one praises no-charge honesty—these are genuine trust themes.
The Google Places API does not reveal whether the owner has responded to reviews; responding to reviews (especially any future critical ones) is a recognized trust and engagement signal.
findings.recommendation: Log in to Google Business Profile, check whether you've responded to your 10 existing reviews, and commit to responding to every new review within 48 hours going forward.

sections.title: Website & Online Presence
sections.summary: The website at rimmerelectric.com is HTTPS-secured, mobile-friendly, includes three click-to-call links, and has a homepage title that names the trade and service area—but it is missing LocalBusiness structured data, a known relevance signal for local search.

findings.observation: The website does not include LocalBusiness structured data (schema.org markup); this markup helps search engines understand the business name, address, phone, hours, and service area, and is a recognized local-search best practice.
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data to the homepage, including name, address, phone, hours, and service areas (Shreveport, Bossier Parish, Benton, Minden); use Google's Rich Results Test to validate it.

findings.observation: The homepage title is 'Electrical Services | Shreveport, Bossier Parish, Benton & Minden, LA | Rimmer Electric Inc'—it includes the trade (electrical) and the service area (Shreveport and surrounding cities), which is a strong relevance signal.
The site is HTTPS-secured, has a mobile viewport, and includes three click-to-call (tel:) links, making it easy for mobile searchers to call directly from the homepage.

sections.title: Call Handling & Contact Paths
sections.summary: The profile lists phone (318) 221-7490 and the website offers three click-to-call links, but the Monday–Friday 7 AM–4 PM hours leave no coverage for evening or weekend calls.

findings.observation: The profile shows hours of Monday–Friday 7 AM–4 PM and closed on weekends; this leaves no listed coverage for evening or weekend emergency calls, which are common in the electrical trade.
findings.recommendation: If you offer after-hours or emergency service, add that information to your profile description and website; if you don't, consider setting up a voicemail or text-back system that acknowledges after-hours calls and promises a next-business-day callback.

findings.observation: The profile lists a phone number and the website includes three click-to-call links, providing clear contact paths for searchers on both mobile and desktop.

fix_list.action: Ask every satisfied customer for a Google review after job completion, aiming for 2–3 new reviews per month.
fix_list.rationale: The most recent review visible is from 5 years ago, making the profile appear dormant; fresh reviews are a high-impact trust and recency signal that directly influence searcher choice and local ranking factors.
fix_list.where: Send a text or email with a direct link to your Google review page (find it at google.com/business or in the Google Business Profile app under 'Get more reviews').

fix_list.action: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data to your homepage, including name, address, phone, hours, and service areas.
fix_list.rationale: The website is missing LocalBusiness schema, a recognized relevance signal that helps search engines understand your business details and service area (Shreveport, Bossier Parish, Benton, Minden).
fix_list.where: Ask your web developer to add the markup to rimmerelectric.com, or use a plugin if on WordPress; validate it at search.google.com/test/rich-results.

fix_list.action: Check whether you've responded to your 10 existing Google reviews, and commit to responding to every new review within 48 hours.
fix_list.rationale: The API does not show owner responses; responding to reviews is a recognized engagement and trust signal, and it shows future customers you value feedback.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Reviews -> click 'Reply' under each review.

fix_list.action: Add after-hours or emergency service information to your Google profile description and website homepage if you offer it.
fix_list.rationale: Your listed hours are Monday–Friday 7 AM–4 PM, closed weekends; if you handle emergency calls outside these hours, stating that can capture urgent-need searchers who might otherwise skip your profile.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Edit profile -> Business description, and add a line to your homepage hero or header.

fix_list.action: Upload 5–10 new photos showing recent electrical projects, your team, and service vehicles.
fix_list.rationale: The profile shows 10 or more photos, but adding fresh project images strengthens relevance and gives searchers confidence that you're active and capable.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Photos -> Add photos (use your phone or camera; label them with brief descriptions like 'Panel upgrade in Shreveport' or 'Rimmer Electric team').

fix_list.action: Set up a voicemail or text-back system that acknowledges after-hours calls and promises a next-business-day callback.
fix_list.rationale: With no listed evening or weekend hours, callers outside 7 AM–4 PM weekdays may assume you're unavailable; a clear voicemail or auto-text reassures them and reduces the chance they'll call a competitor.
fix_list.where: Configure your business phone voicemail or use a service like Google Voice, Grasshopper, or your carrier's voicemail-to-text feature.

not_checked: Whether you've responded to your 10 existing Google reviews — the API does not reveal owner responses. Log in to Google Business Profile -> Reviews to check and respond if you haven't.

Your actual Google Maps ranking for 'electrician Shreveport' or similar searches — this audit does not measure search position. Open an incognito browser, search 'electrician near Shreveport LA,' and note where Rimmer Electric appears.

Whether your phone number rings to a live person or voicemail during and after business hours — call (318) 221-7490 from a different phone during the day and again after 4 PM to confirm the experience matches customer expectations.

How many total photos are actually on your profile — the API shows 10, which is a floor; log in to Google Business Profile -> Photos to see the full count and assess whether more recent images would help.
closing_note: Rimmer Electric has a solid foundation—accurate profile, strong rating, good website—but the 5-year review gap is the single biggest drag on visibility and trust. Restarting review collection and adding structured data are high-impact moves that require minimal investment and directly address the gaps this audit found in your real data.
